caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a rake-like tool composed of a vertical cylindrical wooden handle attached at a right angle to a rectangular wooden block, from which a series of parallel, evenly spaced, elongated wooden tines extend horizontally to the right. The handle is medium brown with visible wood grain and a circular hole near its upper section. The block, matching the handle in color and texture, securely holds the tines, which are thinner and a slightly darker brown, appearing smooth and straight, with their tips splayed slightly at different angles. The entire object is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional elements or details.
title: Hatchel (Flax Comb)
